title: Reddit aims to make ‘karma’ less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation tools
excerpt: Reddit is expanding its moderation tools and building stronger abuse prevention systems that it says could eventually reduce communities’ reliance on karma and account-age requirements, making it easier for legitimate newcomers to participate.
content_html:
Reddit on Wednesday announced a series of changes to its infrastructure and tools, designed to make it easier for people to participate on its site, protect against scraping and spam, and aid in the moderation of its online communities. In addition to providing a new suite of moderation tools, the company said it’s working on more advanced abuse prevention systems that could eventually help communities move away from using things like account age and “karma” to determine who’s allowed to post.

Karma, Reddit’s digital reputation system, allows users to raise their score by posting and commenting helpful, friendly, or funny responses that lead to upvotes. Originally designed to weed out spam, bots, and trolls, many communities came to rely on karma and other account-age restrictions that make it difficult for legitimate newcomers to participate in their communities. Reddit says it now wants to shift to stronger, built-in abuse prevention systems to do more of the moderation work, so communities can be more open to new users.

Reddit didn’t say karma would go away entirely with these coming changes, but it did suggest that its importance could dwindle in the future.

“This will make it easier for genuine new users to participate and easier for mods to welcome them with confidence,” Reddit’s announcement stated.

Related to this, the company said it’s expanding the test of its new suite of AI-powered moderation tools, the Rules Hub, which helps moderators by choosing when to automatically enforce certain community rules and what action should be taken when doing so. Initially used by 700-plus communities, Reddit says that all new communities can now test the tool. Later this year, the tool will be widely available to all communities, both new and existing.

With Rules Hub, Reddit uses large language models (LLMs) to determine whether a post or comment matches the intent of a rule, which the company says allows it to “better handle nuance,” natural language, and edge cases.

Reddit also expanded the capabilities of other tools, including one that helps moderators inform users about their community’s rules when posting and commenting, and another that helps members set their flair — a custom tag users append to their name that only appears in the community they’re posting in.

“Today, new users can encounter invisible barriers like account age and karma thresholds, unclear removals, and poor community discovery,” Reddit explained. “We want new users around the world to be able to easily find relevant communities, understand their rules and norms, and make useful contributions.”

The company also said it would make changes to its legacy desktop site, Old Reddit, by shifting its moderator workflows to its new stack and migrating other critical bots.

On Reddit’s second-quarter earnings call with investors last week, company executives stressed that one of Reddit’s near-term goals was to convert its half-billion weekly active users to daily users through product updates. The company had crushed earnings with revenue of $805 million and earnings per share of $1.25, above estimates, but still saw its stock sink because of what Reddit CEO Steve Huffman described as “choppy” search referral traffic.

content_html_zh:
Reddit 周三宣布对其基础设施和工具进行一系列更改，旨在让人们更轻松地参与其网站，防止抓取和垃圾邮件，并帮助管理其在线社区。 除了提供一套新的审核工具外，该公司表示正在开发更先进的滥用预防系统，最终可以帮助社区不再使用帐户年龄和“业力”等因素来确定谁可以发帖。

Karma 是 Reddit 的数字声誉系统，允许用户通过发布和评论有用、友好或有趣的回复来提高分数，从而获得点赞。 最初旨在清除垃圾邮件、机器人和巨魔，许多社区开始依赖业力和其他帐户年龄限制，这使得合法的新人很难参与他们的社区。 Reddit 表示，它现在希望转向更强大的内置滥用预防系统来完成更多的审核工作，以便社区可以对新用户更加开放。

Reddit 并没有说业力会随着这些即将到来的变化而完全消失，但它确实表明它的重要性在未来可能会减弱。

Reddit 的公告称：“这将使真正的新用户更容易参与，模组也更容易充满信心地欢迎他们。”

与此相关的是，该公司表示正在扩大对其新的人工智能驱动的审核工具套件“规则中心”的测试，该工具可以通过选择何时自动执行某些社区规则以及执行此操作时应采取哪些行动来帮助审核员。 Reddit 最初被 700 多个社区使用，现在所有新社区都可以测试该工具。 今年晚些时候，该工具将广泛提供给所有新社区和现有社区。

通过规则中心，Reddit 使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来确定帖子或评论是否符合规则的意图，该公司表示，这使其能够“更好地处理细微差别”、自然语言和边缘情况。

Reddit 还扩展了其他工具的功能，其中一个工具可以帮助版主在发帖和评论时告知用户其社区的规则，另一个工具可以帮助成员设置自己的才能——用户在其姓名上附加一个自定义标签，该标签仅出现在他们发帖的社区中。

Reddit 解释说：“如今，新用户可能会遇到隐形障碍，例如帐户年龄和业力阈值、不明确的删除以及不良的社区发现。” “我们希望世界各地的新用户能够轻松找到相关社区，了解他们的规则和规范，并做出有用的贡献。”

该公司还表示，将对其传统桌面网站 Old Reddit 进行更改，将其审核工作流程转移到新堆栈并迁移其他关键机器人。

在上周与投资者举行的 Reddit 第二季度财报电话会议上，公司高管强调，Reddit 的近期目标之一是通过产品更新将其 5 亿周活跃用户转化为日常用户。 该公司的营收为 8.05 亿美元，每股收益为 1.25 美元，超出预期，但由于 Reddit 首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼 (Steve Huffman) 描述的搜索推荐流量“不稳定”，其股价仍然下跌。

当您通过我们文章中的链接购买时，我们可能会赚取少量佣金。 这并不影响我们的编辑独立性。
